$comment: How long a text of each surface may be (E65 C5; S18-33, DB11). The surfaces are docs/text-style.md's (section 3), the numbers its section 4: words, counted per string.

DB11 (the owner, binding): a target that goes to the report and a hard limit of about 1.5 times the target, FAIL for the player's and the settings' texts; the GM's diagnostics only reported (limit null); an allow list with a reason.

The targets are rebuilt 30.10 from DB11 and Appendix A section 4 of the stage's plan, to confirm in the pilot (DB23); each limit is the target times 1.5, rounded up. No text of the module is over a budget by these numbers until the pilot has confirmed them.

`rules`: the first rule that names a key gives its surface; `keys` is a regular expression over the whole key (en.json, pl.json, and config.mjs's prose by its DRPG.Config.* key), `sender` the functions that post it (scripts/tests-text.mjs SENDERS). A key no rule names is "unclassified" in the report.

`allow`: one key silenced for one rule (T4, T16, or an X rule of the guide), with `why` and the stage that may remove it (`until`). A row without `why` is a schema error (tests-text.mjs budgetsSchema, red in `node tools/check.mjs text`).
Who reads it: T4 (lengthOver, E65 C6) and T5 (the allow list), through `node tools/check.mjs text`. Nothing at a table reads it (export-ignore).
status: rebuilt 30.10 from DB11 and Appendix A section 4, to confirm in the pilot

tile-label.what: The action tile's name: the player acting, and the GM.

tile-hint.what: What the tile's action does and what it costs, under its name: the player acting.

config-description.what: A description in config.mjs's tables (a Call's effect, a Remnant type, a crisis action): whoever the table is shown to.

button.what: A button's label: whoever holds the window.

window-title.what: A window's title: whoever holds the window.

tab.what: A tab's label inside a window: whoever holds the window.

tooltip.what: What a control does or what a number means, on hover: whoever points at it.

settings-hint.what: The hint under a setting: the GM for a world setting, each user for their own client setting.

toast.what: A notification on this browser alone: the user whose action raised it.

player-card.what: A chat card whispered to a player (and the GMs): the player it is about.

gm-card.what: A chat card whispered to the GMs alone.

world-voice.what: A card posted to the whole table: everyone, in the world's neutral voice (DB1).

gm-diagnostics.what: The health check, the debug log, the contract notice, the suite's own texts: a GM, or whoever helps one.

rules.note: The groups read 31.10: the health check and its report (Diagnostics, Diagnose), the debug log (Failures), the contract notice (Contract), the suite's own texts (Tests), the GM store's faults (GmStore).
By the key's name alone: a card's heading named ...Title is read as a window title by this rule.
A card announce posts with no whisper list; one with a list is private (utils.mjs announce), and goes to the player or GM card by its list.
